*   **Community:** Check out **[hermes-anywhere](/?date=2026-10-27&category=news#item-3f757d6bb1c2)**, a new community-built Flutter and Cupertino client that allows seamless cross-platform access and session continuity across Windows and Android.

items.title: hermes-anywhere (Workspaces & GUIs)
items.content: Hermes Anywhere is a Flutter and Cupertino client for Hermes Agent, with the same interface and sessions on Windows and Android. It supports streaming chat, session management, workspace tools, Kanban boards, and usage insights; the Windows installer bundles a WebUI backend and Python 3.11 runtime.
